scope: Eight static frames for real cellar owners and existing crop stages/products, plus one continuous ordinary masonry terrain frame. No new spawns, animation or runtime integration claim.

frames.description: Three broad pale treads rise between short stone cheeks toward a clear upper opening; no vertical doorway or descent pit.
frames.actualUse: The real upward stair uses the existing registered connection back to the glade.
frames.limits: Owned upward-stair and physics identity. No invented ladder, door, glow or additional destination.

frames.description: Squat closed plank crate with broad corner braces, recessed central boards and a flat upper rail; no chest latch or arched lid.
frames.actualUse: Finite existing container; the actual crate carries clay, a seed-dependent equipment reward and a manual.
frames.limits: Contents and empty state do not change this frame. No persistent open-lid state exists; no supplies are painted onto the crate.

frames.description: Broad low wooden slats across two visible runners, with open spaces between the three boards; larger and heavier than loose split timber.
frames.actualUse: Existing solid haulable owner. Dismantling its unspent harvest removes it and yields two real SalvagedTimber units.
frames.limits: No inventory, carried supply pile or depleted-pallet variant. Player strength and action readiness remain gameplay decisions.

frames.description: A tiny planted seed notch set in a low uneven soil mark; distinct from the pale loose seed and no premature green shoot.
frames.actualUse: Current owned sootroot GrowthStage0; moisture and elapsed-world growth belong to CropPart and cultivated ground.
frames.limits: No wooden planter, readiness icon or fixed-duration promise. The underlying prepared bed is a separate real floor owner.

frames.description: Paired angular olive leaves on one short stem above a low soil footing; no harvest bulb or ripe crown.
frames.actualUse: Current owned sootroot GrowthStage1. Watering modifies actual prepared-ground state rather than a separate decorative plant.
frames.limits: No invented wilted or harvested state. The actual crop must retain its mature-harvest pulp and cultivated-seed contract.

frames.description: Three angular olive leaves rise from dark root shoulders with one restrained pale vertical seam; the root remains planted and uncut.
frames.actualUse: Current owned sootroot GrowthStage2. Mature harvest removes this owner and produces actual pulp and seed.
frames.limits: Do not render a spent crop after harvest. Positive yield counts and actual owned part state are authoritative; growth timing is not painted.

frames.description: One compact torn root portion with charcoal skin and a pale irregular interior; no bottle or whole live plant.
frames.actualUse: Actual harvested, takeable, applicable burning cure. It is not a drinkable healing tonic.
frames.limits: No flames, water pool, shine, stack-count imagery or invented processing output.

frames.description: One small diagonal dark kernel with a pale crease; free of soil, packet and roots.
frames.actualUse: Actual harvested takeable seed that plants SootrootCrop on cultivated soil.
frames.limits: The ground mark and carried seed are different owners. Art does not promise multiple seeds or change valid stack quantities.

frames.description: Full-cell quiet stone courses with staggered dark joints; continuous solid mass at all cell boundaries, no surface-ruin pillar cutouts.
frames.actualUse: Existing ordinary StoneWall with current owned solid, non-takeable physics and its Wall tag.
frames.limits: Terrain exception: all 16x24 pixels are opaque, including row23, so repeated walls do not imply passable gaps. No 3D cap, invented opening, glade VisualID or added collision.
